description: This file is a script used for auditing documentation links within a docs directory of a project. It reads configuration, processes markdown files, resolves routes, and checks for broken links including internal pages, files, and anchors. It also includes functionality for preparing a sanitized docs environment for English-only versions, and can run as a command-line tool.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively walks through a directory to list all files, skipping hidden files and directories.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes in a path string for normalization.

methods.name: isLocalizedDocPath
methods.description: Checks if a path corresponds to a localized documentation path based on language code patterns.

methods.name: isGeneratedTranslatedDoc
methods.description: Determines if the given relative path is a generated translated documentation page.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects navigation page entries from a nested navigation object.
